name: Yellowjacket

abilityDetails.Physical Resistance: Fiziksel hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Energy Resistance: Enerji hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Power Sting: Rakip özel saldırı attığında yüksek şok hasarı almasını sağlar.
abilityDetails.Petrify: Düşmanın iyileşme ve güç kazanım hızını azaltır.

signatureAbility:
Hostile Takeover
Special 1: Power Sting has a 100% chance to inflict a [0.7 - 2.1] second Stun Debuff if it expires after lasting its full duration.
Special 2: Gain +5 Core Charge when Petrify ends.
Special 3: Power Sting has a 100% chance to re-apply itself once activated. Chance decreases by [45 - 0]% each time this happens.

abilitySections.title: Nuclear Core - Always Active
content: Each Charge increases the Potency of personal Debuffs by 1% & reduces the opponent's Regeneration Rate by 1%.
Either Champion lands a hit: +1 Charge. 60% Chance.
Opponent Launches a Special Attack: +10 Charge. 100% Chance.

abilitySections.title: Nuclear Core - Meltdown
content: When Charge is gained above the Overheat Point, there's a chance to enter Meltdown for 12 seconds. Chance increases with Charge.
While Meltdown is active: Any contact with the opponent has a 75% chance to inflict a burst of [1,495.55] Physical Damage on them.
When Meltdown ends: Reset Core back to Starting Charge.

abilitySections.title: Incoming Unblockable Special Attacks
content: Each hit has 100% chance to spend 10 Nuclear Core Charge to reduce the opponent's Attack Rating by 75%.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks - Mystic Opponent
content: Personal Debuffs trigger when the attack is launched instead of on hit and they are Paused for the duration of the attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Inflicts up to 3 Power Sting Debuffs, with each having a 90% chance to activate and lasting 10 seconds. An opponent with Power Sting takes [3,204.75] direct damage if they activate a Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 100% chance to inflict a Petrify Debuff of 50% Potency for 15 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to inflict an indefinite Power Sting Debuff causing [9,400.6] direct damage to the opponent if they activate a Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Hostile Takeover

Special 2: Gain +5 Core Charge when Petrify ends.
